lines.zh: 我浮着走，脚下没有影子。
lines.en: I drift; no shadow beneath me.

lines.zh: 紫黑的一点光，在树间移动。
lines.en: A fleck of violet light moves among the trees.

lines.zh: 我飘过的地方，空气变凉。
lines.en: The air cools where I drift.
No legs, yet I travel.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根黑色的柱子。
lines.en: I circle a black pillar.
The light on me pulses.
I rise a foot above the ground.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶弯了。
lines.en: Grass bends where I pass.
I am not fast, and I make no sound.
My tail is a wisp of smoke.
Where the light is, there I drift.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，末地的砂在动。
lines.en: End stone stirs where I pass.
I hang in this one block of air.
Light slowly turns around me.
I listen to the void.
My eyes are two dots.
The wind of the End has no scent.
I shrink, then expand.

lines.zh: 我身边飘着细小的紫粒。
lines.en: Fine violet motes drift around me.

lines.zh: 我在这片浮岛上待久了。
lines.en: I have been on this island long.
I do not need to breathe at all.
An ender pearl rolls by.
I rise half a block.

lines.zh: 我的光把地面照成紫色。
lines.en: My light stains the ground violet.
So you came here too.
Can you see my light?
The presence on you is loud.
I am no ordinary wisp.
My death would be worth a great deal.
How long have you watched me?
The End has no roads, only islands.
Your blade is glowing.
Step back. The light stings.
I do not belong here.
Reach all you like. You can't hold me.
I drift faster than you walk.
Keep that fire away from me.
I am light. I hold on to nothing.

lines.zh: 光被撞散，我一时收不拢。
lines.en: My light scatters, and I can't gather it.
I gather into a point of light.
Part of me went dark.
I drifted half a step away.
This pain is cold.
My edges are fraying.
I am still in place.
Touch my light, and you'll pay it back.
I know that feeling.

lines.zh: 你打散了我半缕末地微光。
lines.en: You scattered half a thread of my ender glow.
What is that light?
That glow stings brighter than mine.
Bring it here so I can see.
Ender pearl. I know it.
That energy smells sweet.
I don't eat. I only want a closer look.
Set it on that stone.
One step back and I will come.
I cannot carry this away.
A little higher. I cannot see it.
You passed through my light.
I have no body at all.
Your hand went cold.

lines.zh: 我从你的袖子里飘过去。
lines.en: I drift straight through your sleeve.
Passing through makes no sound.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我光里变紫。
lines.en: Your shadow turns violet in my light.
Do not come this close.
Leave some space between us.
I floated half a block higher.
See? I have no weight.
I am only a wisp.
I have no such form.
Few of my kind in the End.
Light leaves no offspring.
Do not ask about it.
I would only drift away.
That topic does not fit me.
I have no heart to give.
See? I do not even have hands.
I am drifting off now.
I cannot touch it at all.
It passed through my light.

lines.zh: 我只能把它托起来一点。
lines.en: I can only lift it a little.
This one is perfectly round.
I lift it half an inch with my light.
It took my light and turned violet.
This will sink.
I nudge it toward you.
I cannot keep hold of it at all.
You pick it up.
The air around you just went cold.
I have spotted you.
I drift back a little.
My light begins to sting.
The End islands are narrow.
There is no hiding from this.
You're blocking the path I drift along.
It's wide open here. Nowhere to hide.
Where your light goes, I follow.
I have other ways.
Do not follow me.
I begin to drift over.
I hang above the back of your neck.
You have looked up.
My light is on your face.
I always drift half a block closer.
The wind of the End is shrill.
I have no need to come near.
I'm waiting for that one blink.
Your blade has risen.
Three more counts will do.
Just like this. Do not move.
Stop blinking.
I skirt the edge of the floating island.
Close your eyes.
My light strikes your chest.
Violet spreads over you.
My shadow claws once.
Not a whisper of sound.
Half a step back, your breath ragged.
My light draws tight.
You are heavy. I cannot push.
This much pain will stay with you.
I drift back again.
One more like that.
See? The End keeps people.
Do not inch any closer.
I rise from the edge of the void.
A violet glow flashes first.

lines.zh: 末地的砂被我的光染了。
lines.en: My light stains the end stone.
No other wisp is here.
I rise, and the air chills.
I came from not far off.
I called out, silently.
My eyes have opened.
Something is near me.
I drift slowly upward.
The void lies below.
I have floated up from below.
The light spreads in a ring.
The heat of the fire pushes me back.
I sink, then rise again.
There is no void in water. It is wrong.
The blast scatters my light.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and hits nothing.
This light is stronger than mine.
I do not starve, yet I fade.
Lightning makes all of me flare.

lines.zh: 虚空本来就是我来的地方。
lines.en: The void is where I come from.
